bibliographic.title: Every Path to Purgatory
bibliographic.author: AngelicDirt
bibliographic.description:
You awaken in a place far removed from our world. What you find there is a problem, a solution (perhaps), and maybe a friend or two.

-=-

''Every Path to Purgatory'' is (hopefully) the first in a series of CYOA-style pieces of interactive fiction based on a set of my dreams involving life, death, and the gathering and hunting of stray souls... it's complicated, don't ask. >.>;

This version is for general testing. I haven't messed with Twine in a bit, so I don't want to go too fast. (First release will be 0.1.0., after which I'll consider the project 'done'...) It currently features 4 endings, two major paths, a fairly sight-friendly font and color palatte, and about three editing passes... about.
